name: Analytic Marching
definition: A meshing algorithm that recovers an explicit polygon mesh Z from an implicit surface function F implemented by a ReLU-based Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP). It exploits the fact that ReLU MLPs partition input space into linear regions, allowing the zero-level isosurface to be identified analytically within these regions rather than approximated via discrete sampling.
summary: Analytic Marching extracts the exact zero-level isosurface of a ReLU-based MLP as a polygon mesh by solving linear systems analytically, ensuring precision independent of grid resolution.
